subject: Do Accept and Reject respond immediately, show clear last-decision and saving activity, remain responsive while persistence runs, and avoid auxiliary terminal windows?
acceptanceCriteria: Accept/Reject produce immediate visual feedback and do not freeze the graphical window while durable persistence is pending.
The workbench visibly communicates last decision and background persistence activity.
Normal decision persistence does not open an auxiliary terminal or console window.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. M038 changes the human-review UI itself, so these blocking UX/visual items require repository-user approval.
